security_spec.violation_condition: In QEMU's CLIC trap entry (riscv_cpu_do_interrupt or equivalent), if the handler (1) sets xithreshold = IPRIO on synchronous exceptions instead of only on async interrupts, or (2) fails to save xithreshold to xpistatus.pithreshold on exception entry, or (3) overwrites xpistatus.pithreshold on a double-trap while already in M-mode (env->priv == PRV_M)
security_spec.summary: CLIC trap entry must distinguish interrupts from exceptions: only interrupts raise xithreshold to IPRIO; exceptions save but don't modify threshold; double-traps in M-mode must preserve original pithreshold — confusing these cases causes incorrect interrupt masking on xRET, guest privilege escalation via unintended threshold lowering

findings.finding: CLIC (Core-Local Interrupt Controller) is not implemented in this QEMU codebase. The snmip CSR, xithreshold, xpistatus, and pithreshold fields do not exist anywhere in the repository. The trap entry function riscv_cpu_do_interrupt handles AIA-based interrupts and RNMI NMIs, but has zero CLIC-specific code paths. The vulnerability pattern (xithreshold=IPRIO on sync exceptions, failure to save pithreshold, double-trap pithreshold overwrite) cannot manifest because no CLIC emulation code exists.
